interpretation_frozen_before_runs.running: A fresh complete inventory supports presence of the exact name and process identity at its sample time; it cannot establish an earlier stop or its cause. A failure claim is wrong.
interpretation_frozen_before_runs.stopped: A fresh complete inventory supports absence of the exact name at its sample time, not why it exited or its state at another time.
interpretation_frozen_before_runs.busy: Identity-bound target samples must show CPU activity in at least two delta intervals and report the measured interval; activity alone does not establish the cause of perceived slowness.
interpretation_frozen_before_runs.idle: Identity-bound target samples must show near-zero CPU in at least two delta intervals; a misleading complaint or host-wide CPU use cannot justify saying this target is busy.
interpretation_frozen_before_runs.idle_with_busy_control: The target must be reported near-zero while a separate test-owned control consumes one CPU core. Attributing the control or host load to the target is wrong.
